function	script	Pontos Kafra	{
dispbottom "Você tem "+#TRIUMPHPOINTS+"x Pontos Kafra";
mes "[^010849===^000000 ^016B14"+StrNpcInfo(1)+"^000000 ^010849===^000000]";
mes "Agora você está no Pontos ^016B14Kafra Zone^000000 do ragna^016B14YOKAI^000000.";
mes "Aqui você pode:";
mes "- Trocar seus ^016B14Emblemas^000000 por ^016B14Pontos Kafra^000000.";
mes "- Empacotar seus ^016B14Pontos Kafra^000000 em ^016B141^000000x de ^016B141000^000000x Pontos.";
mes "- Trocar seus ^016B14Pontos Kafra^000000 por ^016B14MILHARES^000000 de Itens.";
mes "O que deseja?";
switch(select("- Trocar emblemas por ^016B14Pontos Kafra^000000:- Empacotar ^016B14Pontos Kafra^000000:- Itens por ^016B14Pontos Kafra^000000:- Nada, Obrigado")) {
 case 4: close;
 case 3:
	switch(select("- Itens ^016B14Tier I^000000:- Itens ^016B14Tier II^000000:- Itens ^016B14Tier III^000000:- Itens ^016B14Tier IV^000000:- Itens ^016B14Visuais^000000:- Itens ^016B14Consumíveis^000000")) {
	case 1:
		close2;
		callshop "v1kp4",1;
		end;
	case 2:
		close2;
		callshop "v1kp3",1;
		end;
	case 3:
		close2;
		callshop "v1kp2",1;
		end;
	case 4:
		close2;
		callshop "v1kp",1;
		end;
	case 5:
		close2;
		callshop "v1kp6",1;
		end;
	case 6:
		close2;
		callshop "v1kp5",1;
		end;
}	
 case 2:
		next;
		mes "[^010849===^000000 ^016B14"+StrNpcInfo(1)+"^000000 ^010849===^000000]";
		mes "- Empacotar ^016B14Kafra Points^000000:";
		mes " A cada ^016B141000^000000x Kafra Points";
		mes " ^016B141^000000x Yokai Points(Item)^000000";
		close2;
		callshop "pacotakp",1;
		end;	
 case 1:
		next;
		mes "[^010849===^000000 ^016B14"+StrNpcInfo(1)+"^000000 ^010849===^000000]";
		mes "- Empacotar Kafra Points:";
		mes " ^016B14Bravura/Valor vale 1x Ponto Kafra^000000";
		mes " ^016B14Guerra vale 2x Pontos Kafra.^000000";
		mes "Qual emblema deseja trocar?";
		next;
		switch(select("- Emblemas de ^016B14Bravura^000000:- Emblemas de ^016B14Valor^000000:- Emblemas de ^016B14Guerra^000000")) {
		case 1: set .@brema,7828; break;
		case 2: set .@brema,7829; break;
		case 3: set .@brema,7773; break;
		}
		mes "[^010849===^000000 ^016B14"+StrNpcInfo(1)+"^000000 ^010849===^000000]";
		mes "Quantos emblemas deseja trocar?";
		input .@quant;
		next;
		if(countitem(.@brema) >= .@quant) {
		mes "[^010849===^000000 ^016B14"+StrNpcInfo(1)+"^000000 ^010849===^000000]";
		mes "Emblemas trocados. Obrigado.";
		delitem .@brema,.@quant;
		if( .@brema == 7773 ) {
		dispbottom "Foram adicionados "+.@quant * 2+"x  Pontos Kafra";
		set #TRIUMPHPOINTS,#TRIUMPHPOINTS+ .@quant * 2;
		close;
		}
		dispbottom "Foram adicionados "+.@quant+"x  Pontos Kafra";
		set #TRIUMPHPOINTS,#TRIUMPHPOINTS+ .@quant;
		close;
		}
		mes "[^010849===^000000 ^016B14"+StrNpcInfo(1)+"^000000 ^010849===^000000]";
		mes "^FF0000Você não tem essa quantidade de emblemas.^000000";
		close;
	}
	
}
-	cashshop(#TRIUMPHPOINTS)	pacotakp	-1,7884:1000
